changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Company' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SynchAgentLog') begin if exists (select sdc.name from sys.default_constraints sdc where object_name(sdc.parent_object_id) = 'Company' and sdc.name = 'DF_Company_SynchAgentLog' ) begin alter table [dbo].[Company] drop constraint DF_Company_SynchAgentLog; end
alter table [dbo].[Company] drop column [SynchAgentLog] end
changeSet.rollback:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Company' and COLUMN_NAME = 'SynchAgentLog') begin alter table [dbo].[Company] add [SynchAgentLog] [bit]
alter table [dbo].[Company] add constraint [DF_Company_SynchAgentLog] default ((0)) FOR [SynchAgentLog] end
